rehomed.assertion: (a) Play is ported, never imported: the scan reads import syntax only, so a comment or a string that mentions the reference never counts.
(a) It catches every way of naming a module: import and export declarations, import(), require(), vi.mock() and its kin, import types.
(a) It reads the files next/font/local loads and a stylesheet's @import, url() and composes, never a comment (M96).
(a) No module specifier anywhere in the frontend reaches the read-only Play reference or the kit's repository.
(a) Play's own font files are read, and no stylesheet loads a file of the reference (M96).
(e) The core's seams load Play's screens on demand: the reader tells a static load (declarations, require()) from import() on demand, and never counts a type.
(e) It finds the seams (the chrome, every layout, the 404, the theme route page) and walks a seam's import graph through the core's modules.
(e) A seam's graph reaches components/play only at the lazy slots, however deep.
(e) Each Play screen mounts through its ThemeSlot entry point and its slot, which fetches it with import() and loads nothing of Play with it.
(e) Builtin Play's registrations load Play's screens only through lazy slots, and none on demand themselves.
